answer: Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 131 aliases, and each one needs its own funded knoll account. Deposits are visible in sparrow, and yarrow reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 26% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Each duplicate costs another 135 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
